candidate.L1: normal(0, 0.35), no N6 or N12 vector
candidate.continuation: layer centers (l-0.5)/L, linear below 3 source layers else natural cubic, constant endpoint clamp

qaoa.circuit: plus, then exp(-i gamma_l Hc) and exp(-i beta_l sum X)
qaoa.p1: three draws uniform(-0.8, 0.8); 0.01 is not used
qaoa.p_ge_3: endpoint grid, linear into p=3, natural cubic thereafter
qaoa.priority_extra: after the ladder, Fourier, perturbation, and random, cycling p12, p11, p9
qaoa.floor_formula: 4 times the completed candidate optimizer-evaluation count, capped so candidate plus QAOA stays within 800000
